svg.title: Cosine weights show odd-mode removal; labeled symmetric channels distinguish mirrors but their sum does not.
svg.desc: Odd cosine modes have exactly zero midpoint weight; moving to x=0.49 retains some of them. For the two alternative sources 0.23 and 0.77 with A=1,D=0.05, the labeled measurements at 1/3 and 2/3 are different: reflection swaps the channels. Their sum removes this distinguishing contrast. Thus a spatially symmetric pair of labeled sensors is not inherently aliased; aggregation is a different observation operator.
svg.title: Cosine weights show odd-mode removal; labeled symmetric channels distinguish mirrors but their sum does not.
